book_name: 同桌英语《刘夏来语料库》6 考点词/同义替换

words.tr: phrase. 不容错过的；绝不能错过的
words.ex: This concert is not to be missed.
words.ex_cn: 这场音乐会不容错过。
words.en: If you say that something is not to be missed, you mean that it is so good or important that it is worth making an effort to experience or attend it.

words.tr: adj. 更好的；更优秀的；“good”的比较级； adv. 更好地；“well”的比较级； v. 胜过；使更佳；
words.ex: This shirt is better than the other one.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫比那件更好。
words.en: If something is better, it is of a higher standard, quality, or level than something else, or than it was before.

words.tr: adj. 较合意的；更可取的；
words.ex: Tea is preferable to coffee in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 早上喝茶比喝咖啡更合意。
words.en: If you say that one thing is preferable to another, you mean that it is more desirable or suitable.

words.tr: v. 鼓励；促进；“encourage”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: My teacher encouraged me to try again.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师鼓励我再试一次。
words.en: If you are encouraged by something, it gives you hope or confidence.

words.tr: 短语. 在...方面的跃升；在...方面的突然增加
words.ex: There was a jump in prices last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月价格有所上涨。
words.en: A sudden and significant increase in something, often numbers or rates.

words.ex: He has a positive attitude toward life.
words.ex_cn: 他对生活持积极的态度。
words.en: If you are positive about things, you are hopeful and confident, and think of the good aspects of a situation rather than the bad ones.

words.tr: adj. 优秀的；杰出的；卓越的；
words.ex: He got an excellent score on the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中取得了优异的成绩。
words.en: Something that is excellent is very good indeed.

words.ex: He works hard to improve his English.
words.ex_cn: 他努力改善自己的英语。
words.en: To make something better, or to become better.

words.tr:
v. 有益于；有助于；
n. 利益；好处；
words.ex: Exercise benefits your health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼有益于你的健康。
words.en: A benefit is something that helps you or improves your life in some way.

words.tr: v. 扩大；扩张；“expand”的现在分词； adj. 扩展的；扩充的；
words.ex: The company is expanding its business to new cities.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司正在将其业务扩大到新城市。
words.en: If something expands or is expanded, it becomes larger.

words.ex: The growth of the plant is slow in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这植物在冬天生长缓慢。
words.en: The process of increasing in physical size, number, value, or strength.

words.tr: adj. 增长的；增多的； v. 增加；“increase”的现在分词；
words.ex: The increasing population needs more food.
words.ex_cn: 增长的人口需要更多的食物。
words.en: Becoming greater in size, amount, or degree.

words.tr: adj. 增加的；增长的；增强的； v. 生长；成长；种植；渐渐变成；“grow”的现在分词； n. 成长；
words.ex: The growing demand for clean water is a big problem.
words.ex_cn: 对清洁水日益增加的需求是一个大问题。
words.en: Increasing in size or amount; developing.

words.tr:
adj. 特别受喜爱的；
n. 特别喜爱的事物；
words.ex: Chocolate is my favourite dessert.
words.ex_cn: 巧克力是我最喜爱的甜点。
words.en: Something or someone that is preferred above all others.

words.tr:
adj. 最好的；
adv. 最好地；
n. 最佳物；佼佼者；最高水平；
words.ex: He is the best player on the team.
words.ex_cn: 他是队里最好的球员。
words.en: Of the most excellent, effective, or desirable type or quality.

words.w: What a great chance this was
words.tr: 这是一个多么好的机会啊
words.uk: wɒt ə ɡreɪt tʃɑːns ðɪs wɒz
words.us: wʌt ə ɡreɪt tʃæns ðɪs wʌz
words.ex: What a great chance this was to win the prize.
words.ex_cn: 这真是一个赢得奖品的好机会。
words.en: An expression of strong appreciation for a valuable opportunity.

words.ex: He showed gratitude for the help.
words.ex_cn: 他表达了对帮助的感激。
words.en: Gratitude is the feeling of being thankful and appreciative.

words.tr: v. 喜欢；享受；过得愉快；“enjoy”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: I enjoyed the movie last night.
words.ex_cn: 我昨晚喜欢这部电影。
words.en: If you enjoy something, you find pleasure and satisfaction in doing it or experiencing it.

words.ex: He was pleased to see his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他很高兴见到他的朋友。

words.tr: phrase. 非常吸引人的事物；主要吸引力
words.ex: The concert is a big draw for young people.
words.ex_cn: 这场音乐会对年轻人来说是个很大的吸引力。
words.en: Something or someone that attracts a lot of people.

words.tr: 短语. 在……方面的增加；……的增长
words.ex: There is an increase in the number of students who like math.
words.ex_cn: 喜欢数学的学生人数增加了。
words.en: A rise in the amount or level of something.

words.tr: 像……这样的人；类似于……的人
words.ex: People like walking in the park after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 人们喜欢晚饭后在公园散步。
words.en: Common individuals or those in a similar situation.

words.tr: phrase. 正面反馈；积极回馈；正反馈
words.ex: He got positive feedback from his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他从老师那里得到了积极的反馈。
words.en: Positive feedback is a response or comment that expresses approval, encouragement, or agreement. It is used to reinforce a behavior or action, making it more likely to be repeated.

words.w: people of all ages can live together happily
words.tr: 各个年龄段的人都能和睦共处
words.uk: ˈpiːpl əv ɔːl eɪdʒɪz kæn lɪv təˈɡeðə ˈhæpɪli
words.us: ˈpiːpl əv ɔːl eɪdʒɪz kæn lɪv təˈɡeðər ˈhæpɪli
words.ex: People of all ages can live together happily.
words.ex_cn: 不同年龄段的人可以快乐地生活在一起。
words.en: Individuals from every age group are able to coexist in a joyful manner.

words.tr: n. 居民之间良好的关系
words.ex: The neighbors have good relations between residents.
words.ex_cn: 邻居们与居民之间关系良好。
words.en: A friendly and cooperative relationship among people living in the same area.

words.tr: adj. 重大的；重要的；影响明显的；
words.ex: This discovery is a significant step forward.
words.ex_cn: 这一发现是一个重大的进步。
words.en: Something that is significant is important or large enough to be noticed or to have an effect.

words.ex: It is important to eat healthy food.
words.ex_cn: 吃健康的食物很重要。
words.en: Something that is important is very significant, is highly valued, or is necessary.

words.tr: phrase. 上升；上涨；增长（go 的过去式 + up，表示向上移动或数量增加）
words.ex: The price went up last week.
words.ex_cn: 价格上周上涨了。
words.en: To move or extend upwards; to increase in level or amount.

words.ex: There was a significant increase in the number of students last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年学生人数有了显著增加。

words.tr: phrase. 巨大的增长；迅猛的发展
words.ex: The city has seen huge growth in population.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市人口出现了巨大增长。
words.en: A very large increase in size, amount, or importance.

words.tr: 短语. 在……方面巨大的增长；在……方面显著的上升
words.ex: There is a huge increase in the number of students taking math.
words.ex_cn: 学习数学的学生人数大幅增加。
words.en: A very large rise or growth in amount, size, or degree.

words.tr: v. 防止此类事故的发生
words.ex: Wearing a helmet can prevent such accidents.
words.ex_cn: 戴头盔可以防止这样的事故。
words.en: Stop such incidents from occurring.

words.ex: The new rules are improving safety at the factory.
words.ex_cn: 新规定正在提高工厂的安全性。

words.ex: Students are recommended to study every day.
words.ex_cn: 建议学生每天学习。

words.ex: The castle is the favourite attraction in the city.
words.ex_cn: 这座城堡是这座城市最受欢迎的景点。

words.ex: The Eiffel Tower is the most popular attraction in Paris.
words.ex_cn: 埃菲尔铁塔是巴黎最受欢迎的景点。

words.tr: adj. 非常兴奋的；极为激动的； v. “thrill”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was thrilled when he won the prize.
words.ex_cn: 当他赢得奖品时，他非常兴奋。
words.en: If someone is thrilled, they are extremely pleased about something.

words.tr: adj. （感到）高兴的；愉快的；满意的； v. “please”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: She was pleased with her test score.
words.ex_cn: 她对自己的考试成绩感到高兴。
words.en: If you are pleased, you are happy or satisfied about something.

words.tr: adj. 必需的；必要的；必然的；
words.ex: Water is necessary for life.
words.ex_cn: 水是生命所必需的。
words.en: If something is necessary, it is needed in order for something else to happen or be done.

words.tr: adj. 必需的；基本的；本质的；
words.ex: Water is essential for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命是必需的。
words.en: Something that is essential is extremely important or absolutely necessary to a particular subject, situation, or activity.

words.tr: n. 利益；好处；“benefit”的复数； v. 有益于；有助于；
words.ex: The benefits of exercise are clear.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼的好处是显而易见的。
words.en: Benefits are advantages or profits that you get from something, especially advantages that you get from the government or from your employer, such as money or health insurance.

words.tr: n. 优势；有利条件；“advantage”的复数； v. 有利于；
words.ex: The advantages of walking to school are clear.
words.ex_cn: 步行上学的优势很明显。
words.en: An advantage is a condition or circumstance that puts one in a favorable or superior position.

words.tr: phrase. 强烈建议；极力劝告
words.ex: I strongly advise you to wear a helmet when riding a bike.
words.ex_cn: 我强烈建议你骑自行车时戴头盔。

words.ex: I recommend this book to you.
words.ex_cn: 我向你推荐这本书。
words.en: If someone recommends a person or thing to you, they suggest that you would find them good or useful.

words.tr: phrase. 吸引人们；引起人们的兴趣
words.ex: The colorful posters appeal to people.
words.ex_cn: 这些色彩鲜艳的海报吸引人们。

words.ex: The new movie has generated great interest to the public.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影引起了公众的极大兴趣。

words.tr: adj. 滑稽的；好笑的；有趣的；
words.ex: The funny clown made everyone laugh.
words.ex_cn: 那个滑稽的小丑让所有人都笑了。
words.en: Something that is funny is amusing and likely to make you laugh.

words.tr: adj. 被逗乐的； v. “amuse”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was amused by the funny cat video.
words.ex_cn: 他被那只搞笑的猫视频逗乐了。
words.en: If you are amused by something, it makes you want to laugh or smile.

words.tr: n. 最佳方式；最好的方法
words.ex: The best way to learn English is to practice every day.
words.ex_cn: 学习英语的最佳方式是每天练习。

words.ex: The primary method to solve this problem is simple addition.
words.ex_cn: 解决这个问题的主要方法是简单的加法。

words.ex: She is an attractive woman.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个有吸引力的女性。
words.en: An attractive person or thing is pleasing or appealing to look at.

words.tr: adj. 引起兴趣的； v. 吸引；“appeal”的现在分词；
words.ex: The book has an appealing story.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有一个引人入胜的故事。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as appealing, you mean that you like them or they make you want to have or do something.

words.ex: He takes pride in helping others.
words.ex_cn: 他以帮助别人为荣。
words.en: To feel a sense of satisfaction or pleasure in one's own achievements, qualities, or possessions, or those of someone with whom one is closely associated.

words.tr: phrase. 为…感到自豪；以…为荣
words.ex: She is proud of her son's achievements.
words.ex_cn: 她为儿子的成就感到自豪。
words.en: Feeling deep pleasure or satisfaction as a result of one's own achievements, qualities, or possessions or those of someone with whom one is closely associated.

words.ex: The movie was fantastic!
words.ex_cn: 这部电影极好！
words.en: If you describe something as fantastic, you are emphasizing that you think it is very good or that you like it a lot.

words.tr:
adj. 极好的；大的；伟大的；
adv. 很好地；
words.ex: This is a great movie!
words.ex_cn: 这是一部极好的电影！
words.en: If you describe someone or something as great, you approve of them or admire them.

words.tr: phrase. 光明的一面；积极的一面
words.ex: There is a bright side to every problem.
words.ex_cn: 每个问题都有积极的一面。
words.en: A positive or optimistic aspect of a situation.

words.tr: n. 优势；有利条件；好处；
words.ex: His height gives him an advantage in basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他的身高在篮球中给了他优势。
words.en: An advantage is a factor or circumstance that puts you in a favorable or superior position.

words.tr:
v. 促进；使增长；
n. 提高；增强；
words.ex: Exercise can boost your energy.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以促进你的精力。
words.en: If one thing boosts another, it causes it to increase, improve, or be more successful.

words.ex: Exercise can enhance your health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以提高你的健康。
words.en: To enhance something means to improve its value, quality, or attractiveness.

words.ex: Exercise can strengthen your muscles.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以增强你的肌肉。
words.en: To strengthen something means to make it stronger or more effective.

words.tr:
v. 增加；增多；
n. 增加；增长；
words.ex: The company increased its profits last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司去年增加了利润。
words.en: To increase something means to make it larger in size, amount, or degree.

words.ex: The price of oil soared last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月石油价格骤升。
words.en: To rise or increase dramatically in amount or level.

words.ex: The number of people using the internet increases rapidly.
words.ex_cn: 使用互联网的人数迅速增加。
words.en: To grow or develop at a very fast rate.

words.tr: phrase. 增强信心；提升自信
words.ex: He practices speaking to increase confidence.
words.ex_cn: 他练习说话以增强信心。
words.en: To make someone feel more assured or self-assured.

words.tr: phrase. 建立自尊；提升自信心
words.ex: Parents should praise their children to build self esteem.
words.ex_cn: 父母应该表扬孩子来建立自尊。

words.ex: There is danger near the river.
words.ex_cn: 河边有危险。
words.en: Danger is the possibility that someone may be harmed or killed.

words.ex: The storm is a threat to the village.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴对村庄构成了威胁。
words.en: A threat is a statement of an intention to inflict pain, injury, damage, or other hostile action on someone in retribution for something done or not done.

words.ex: He complains about the loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 他抱怨那噪音太大。
words.en: If you complain about a situation, you say that you are not satisfied with it.

words.tr: phrase. 对...的关心；对...表示忧虑
words.ex: Parents have concern about their child's safety.
words.ex_cn: 父母对孩子的安全感到担心。
words.en: If you concern about something, you feel worried about it.

words.ex: The smell was unpleasant.
words.ex_cn: 这气味令人不快。
words.en: If something is unpleasant, it gives you bad feelings, for example, by making you feel upset or uncomfortable.

words.tr: n. 不利；劣势；短处；“disadvantage”的复数；
words.ex: The disadvantages of living in the city are high costs and noise.
words.ex_cn: 住在城市里的不利之处是高昂的费用和噪音。
words.en: A disadvantage is a factor which makes someone or something less useful, acceptable, or successful than other people or things.

words.tr: v. 销声匿迹；突然消失；
words.ex: The magic trick made the coin vanish.
words.ex_cn: 这个魔术让硬币销声匿迹了。
words.en: If someone or something vanishes, they disappear suddenly or in a way that cannot be explained.

words.ex: The cat disappeared behind the house.
words.ex_cn: 猫从房子后面消失了。
words.en: If someone or something disappears, they go away or are taken away so that you cannot see them any more.

words.ex: He faced many hardships during the war.
words.ex_cn: 他在战争期间经历了许多困苦。
words.en: Hardship refers to a situation that is difficult to endure because of lack of money, resources, or other basic necessities.

words.ex: He faced difficulty in solving the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决这道数学题时遇到了困难。
words.en: A difficulty is a problem or issue that is hard to deal with or understand.

words.ex: The drawback of this phone is its short battery life.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的缺点是电池续航时间短。
words.en: A drawback is a feature of something that makes it less useful or desirable than it could be.

words.ex: This math problem is very hard.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学难题很难。
words.en: A problem is a situation that is unsatisfactory and causes difficulties for people.

words.tr: phrase. 与……作斗争；努力应对……；艰难处理……
words.ex: He struggled with math last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年在数学上很吃力。
words.en: To try very hard to do something when it is difficult or when there are a lot of problems.

words.tr:
adj. 困难的；坚硬的；费劲的；
adv. 努力地；
words.ex: This math problem is hard.
words.ex_cn: 这个数学题很难。
words.en: If something is hard, it is very difficult to do or deal with. It can also mean that something is solid and firm, not soft or liquid.

words.ex: She is concerned about her son's health.
words.ex_cn: 她担心她儿子的健康。
words.en: To be worried or anxious about something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 抱怨；投诉；对……表示不满
words.ex: He complained about the loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 他抱怨那噪音太大。
words.en: Expressed dissatisfaction or annoyance about something.

words.ex: The river is dangerous for children.
words.ex_cn: 这条河对孩子来说很危险。
words.en: If something is dangerous, it is able or likely to hurt or harm you.

words.ex: The frog is poisonous.
words.ex_cn: 这只青蛙是有毒的。
words.en: Something that is poisonous will kill you or make you ill if you eat it, drink it, or absorb it.

words.tr: phrase. + n. 糟糕的状况；恶劣的条件
words.ex: The workers lived in awful conditions.
words.ex_cn: 工人们生活在恶劣的环境中。
words.en: Extremely unpleasant or bad circumstances or environments.

words.ex: He has many problems with math.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学上有很多问题。
words.en: A problem is a situation that is unsatisfactory and causes difficulties for people.

words.ex: He made a mistake in his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他在作业中犯了一个错误。
words.en: If you make a mistake, you do something which you did not intend to do, or which produces a result that you do not want.

words.tr: n. 减缓；宽慰；解脱；救济；
words.ex: The medicine brought relief to his pain.
words.ex_cn: 这种药缓解了他的疼痛。
words.en: Relief is a feeling of reassurance and relaxation following release from anxiety or distress.

words.tr: adv. 较少地；更少地；“little”的比较级； adj. 更少的；“little”的比较级； pron. 较少；更少；
words.ex: He eats less sugar now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在吃得更少的糖。
words.en: You use less to indicate that there is a smaller amount of something than before or than average. You can use 'less' to indicate that something is smaller in size or degree than another thing.

words.tr: 那真是遗憾；那太可惜了
words.ex: That was a shame he missed the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他没赶上公交车，真遗憾。
words.en: That was a regrettable or unfortunate situation.

words.tr: adj. 失望的；沮丧的； v. “disappoint”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was disappointed when he failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他考试没及格时感到很失望。
words.en: If you are disappointed, you are sad because something has not happened or because something is not as good as you had hoped.

words.tr: 我心想：“这不可能正在发生。”
words.uk: aɪ θɔːt ðɪs kɑːnt bi ˈhæpənɪŋ
words.us: aɪ θɔːt ðɪs kænt bi ˈhæpənɪŋ
words.ex: I thought this can't be happening.
words.ex_cn: 我以为这不可能发生。
words.en: I believed an event was impossible or unreal.

words.ex: He stared at the money with disbelief.
words.ex_cn: 他难以置信地盯着那些钱。
words.en: Disbelief is the feeling of not being able to believe that something is true or real.

words.tr:
n. 损害；破损；
v. 损害；破坏；
words.ex: The storm caused serious damage to the house.
words.ex_cn: 风暴对房屋造成了严重损害。
words.en: Damage is physical harm that is caused to something which makes it less attractive, useful, or valuable.

words.ex: He got an injury while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时受了伤。
words.en: An injury is damage to your body. It is a general term that refers to harm caused by accidents, falls, hits, weapons, etc.

words.ex: He is worried about his exam.
words.ex_cn: 他担心他的考试。

words.tr: n. 负面情绪；消极感受
words.ex: He had a negative feeling about the test.
words.ex_cn: 他对这次考试有一种负面的感觉。
words.en: An unpleasant or adverse emotion.

words.tr: v. 减到最少；使最小化；
words.ex: Try to minimize waste in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 尽量减少厨房里的浪费。
words.en: To minimize something means to reduce it to the smallest possible amount or degree.

words.ex: We need to reduce waste in our daily life.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要减少日常生活中的浪费。
words.en: If you reduce something, you make it smaller in size or amount, or less in degree.

words.ex: He gave up smoking last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年戒烟了。
words.en: If you give up something, you stop doing it or having it.

words.ex: There was a reduction in the number of students this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年学生人数减少了。

words.ex: He is worried about his test score.
words.ex_cn: 他担心自己的考试成绩。
words.en: Feeling or showing concern about actual or potential problems.

words.ex: He is concerned about his grades.
words.ex_cn: 他担心自己的成绩。
words.en: Worried or anxious about something.

words.tr: phrase. 损害；减损；降低……的价值或重要性
words.ex: Don't let small mistakes detract from your great progress.
words.ex_cn: 不要让小错误削弱你的巨大进步。
words.en: To reduce the value, importance, or quality of something.

words.ex: The drug has a negative effect on his health.
words.ex_cn: 这种药物对他的健康有负面影响。
words.en: A negative effect is an adverse or unfavorable outcome or impact that results from a particular action, event, or situation.

words.tr: adj. 无望的；凄凉的；荒凉的；
words.ex: The future looks bleak without a job.
words.ex_cn: 没有工作，未来看起来毫无希望。
words.en: If you describe a situation as bleak, you mean that it seems unlikely to improve or get better.

words.tr: phrase. 处境危险；遭受危险
words.ex: The children are at risk without proper care.
words.ex_cn: 这些孩子如果没有适当的照顾就会有危险。
words.en: In a situation where there is a possibility of something bad happening.

words.ex: Try to lessen your sugar intake.
words.ex_cn: 试着减少你的糖摄入量。
words.en: If something lessens or you lessen it, it becomes smaller in size, amount, degree, or importance.

words.tr:
n. 减少；
v. 减少；降低；
words.ex: There was a decrease in rainfall last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月降雨量减少了。
words.en: If something decreases or you decrease it, it becomes less in quantity, size, or intensity.

words.tr: phrase. 不太可能……；较不可能……
words.ex: He is less likely to fail the test now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在不太可能考试不及格。
words.en: Having a lower probability or chance of happening or being the case.

words.ex: Wearing a helmet can reduce its chances to get hurt.
words.ex_cn: 戴头盔可以减少它受伤的机会。

words.tr: phrase. 远非容易的；一点也不容易
words.ex: The test is far from easy.
words.ex_cn: 这个测试远非容易。
words.en: Very difficult; not at all easy.

words.ex: This math problem is hard to solve.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学题很难解。
words.en: Difficult to; not easy to.

words.tr: adj. 引起烦恼的；令人不安的； v. 打扰；妨碍；“disturb”的现在分词；
words.ex: The movie showed a disturbing scene of violence.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影展示了一个引起烦恼的暴力场景。
words.en: If you describe something as disturbing, you mean that it makes you feel anxious or upset.

words.ex: The old house is not attractive to buyers.
words.ex_cn: 这栋老房子对买家没有吸引力。

words.ex: His neglect of the project caused delays.
words.ex_cn: 他对项目的疏忽导致了延误。
words.en: If you neglect someone or something, you fail to give them the attention or care that they need.

words.ex: He ignored the warning sign.
words.ex_cn: 他忽视了警告标志。
words.en: If you ignore someone or something, you pay no attention to them.

words.ex: The lion killed a deer in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 狮子在森林里杀死了一只鹿。
words.en: To kill someone or something means to cause their death.

words.tr:
n. 伤害；损害；
v. 伤害；损害；
words.ex: The storm caused great harm to the crops.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴对庄稼造成了很大伤害。
words.en: To harm someone or something means to cause them physical injury or to damage them in some other way.

words.tr: adj. 不精确的；不准确的；有错误的；
words.ex: The clock is inaccurate and shows the wrong time.
words.ex_cn: 这个钟不精确，显示的时间不对。
words.en: If a statement or measurement is inaccurate, it is not correct or not exact.

words.ex: The water supply is insufficient for the whole village.
words.ex_cn: 供水对整个村庄来说是不充分的。
words.en: If something is insufficient, it is not enough for a particular purpose.

words.ex: I do not have enough money to buy the book.
words.ex_cn: 我没有足够的钱买这本书。

words.tr: v. 威胁；“threaten”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He threatened to call the police.
words.ex_cn: 他威胁要叫警察。
words.en: If someone or something is threatened, they are in a situation where they may be harmed or damaged.

words.tr: adj. 濒临灭绝的；有灭绝危险的； v. “endanger”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The panda is an endangered animal.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫是一种濒临灭绝的动物。
words.en: An animal or plant that is endangered is in danger of becoming extinct.

words.tr:
n. 担忧；关注；
v. 涉及；
words.ex: His main concern is his child's safety.
words.ex_cn: 他主要的担忧是孩子的安全。
words.en: If something concerns you, it worries you or causes you to feel anxious.

words.tr:
v. 担心；担忧；
n. 担心；忧虑；
words.ex: She worries about her son every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天为她的儿子担心。
words.en: If you worry, you keep thinking about problems that you have or about unpleasant things that might happen.

words.ex: There is nothing interesting on TV tonight.
words.ex_cn: 今晚电视上没什么有趣的内容。

words.tr: adj. 无聊的；令人厌倦的； v. “bore”的现在分词；
words.ex: The movie was boring.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影很无聊。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as boring, you mean that they are not interesting and make you feel tired or impatient.

words.ex: He is not happy with his grade.
words.ex_cn: 他对他的分数不高兴。

words.ex: He was reluctant to leave his home.
words.ex_cn: 他不愿意离开家。
words.en: If you are reluctant to do something, you are unwilling to do it and hesitate before doing it, or do it slowly and without enthusiasm.

words.tr:
n. 颜色；
v. 着色；
words.ex: The sky has a blue colour.
words.ex_cn: 天空有一种蓝色。
words.en: Colour is the appearance that things have that results from the way in which they reflect light. Red, blue, and green are colours.

words.ex: The teacher showed us slides about the solar system.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们展示了关于太阳系的幻灯片。
words.en: Slides can refer to a series of images projected onto a screen or a surface, typically used in presentations, or to a smooth, inclined surface for children to play on by sliding down. As a verb, it means to move smoothly along a surface while maintaining continuous contact with it.

words.ex: The movie has amazing visuals.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影有令人惊叹的视觉效果。
words.en: Visuals refer to the elements of a presentation or display that appeal to the sight, such as pictures, diagrams, or videos, used to make information more accessible or appealing.

words.tr: phrase. 呼吸困难；呼吸障碍
words.ex: He has breathing difficulties when he runs.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步时有呼吸困难。
words.en: Breathing difficulties refer to the condition where a person finds it hard to breathe properly. This can be due to various reasons, including respiratory diseases, allergies, or physical obstructions.

words.ex: He has a health problem with his heart.
words.ex_cn: 他有心脏健康问题。
words.en: A health problem is any condition that affects the physical or mental well-being of an individual.

words.ex: I ate two sandwiches for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 我午餐吃了两个三明治。
words.en: A sandwich is two slices of bread with a layer of food such as cheese or meat between them.

words.ex: He eats healthy food every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃健康的食物。
words.en: Food is what people and animals eat to live and grow.

words.ex: My brother goes to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我弟弟每天早上上学。
words.en: A school is an institution where children are educated.

words.ex: He values education very much.
words.ex_cn: 他非常重视教育。
words.en: Education is the process of teaching and learning, especially in a school or college, or the knowledge that you get from this.

words.tr: phrase. 蔬菜和谷物（泛指植物性食物）
words.ex: She buys vegetables and cereals at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上买蔬菜和谷物。
words.en: Edible plants grown for food, including leafy greens, roots, and grains like wheat and rice.

words.ex: Farmers grow crops like wheat and corn.
words.ex_cn: 农民种植小麦和玉米等农作物。
words.en: Crops are plants such as wheat and potatoes that are grown in large quantities for food.

words.ex: He ate ham for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了火腿。
words.en: Ham is meat from the upper part of a pig's leg that has been preserved with salt or smoke.

words.ex: He eats meat every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃肉。
words.en: Meat is the flesh of an animal that is eaten as food.

words.ex: He eats tuna for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃金枪鱼。
words.en: A tuna is a large fish that lives in warm seas and is caught for food.

words.tr:
n. 鱼；鱼肉；
v. 钓鱼；捕鱼；
words.ex: He caught a big fish in the river.
words.ex_cn: 他在河里钓到了一条大鱼。
words.en: A fish is a creature that lives in water and has a tail and fins. Fish is also the flesh of a fish eaten as food.

words.ex: He cooked pasta or a casserole for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他为晚餐做了意大利面或砂锅菜。
words.en: A dish made from pasta or a baked meal cooked in a pot.

words.tr: phrase. 一顿像样的饭；一顿丰盛的正餐
words.ex: He ate a proper meal after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后吃了一顿正经的饭。
words.en: A complete and balanced meal that provides adequate nutrition.

words.ex: The boy picked up a piece of rubber from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 男孩从地上捡起一块橡胶。
words.en: Rubber is a strong, waterproof, elastic substance made from the juice of some tropical plants or artificially. It is used for making tires, boots, and many other products.

words.tr:
n. 材料；原料；
adj. 物质的；
words.ex: The table is made of wood material.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是由木头材料制成的。
words.en: Material refers to the substance or substances from which a thing is made or can be made, or information or ideas for use in creating a book or other work.

words.tr:
n. 恐慌；
v. 感到恐慌；
words.ex: A panic spread through the crowd when the fire alarm rang.
words.ex_cn: 当火警响起时，人群陷入了恐慌。
words.en: Panic is a very strong feeling of anxiety or fear, which makes you act without thinking carefully.

words.tr: n. 情绪；情感；情感：“emotion”的复数；
words.ex: Children often show their emotions by crying or laughing.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们常常通过哭泣或大笑来表现他们的情绪。
words.en: Feelings such as happiness, sadness, anger, or love, which can be caused by the situation that you are in or the people you are with.

words.tr: 名词短语，指医院和中学（通常指初中或高中阶段的教育机构）
words.ex: The city built a new hospital and secondary school next to each other.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市在旁边新建了一家医院和一所中学。
words.en: A medical institution for treating the sick and a school for students aged 11-18.

words.ex: The school has good facilities for sports.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校有良好的体育设施。
words.en: Facilities are buildings, pieces of equipment, or services that are provided for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The park protects trees and wildlife.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园保护树木和野生动物。
words.en: Plants with a single trunk and the animals and plants living in a natural state.

words.ex: He protects the environment by recycling.
words.ex_cn: 他通过回收利用来保护环境。
words.en: The environment is the natural world in which people, animals, and plants live.

words.ex: He gets headaches after long hours of screen time.
words.ex_cn: 他长时间看屏幕后会头痛。
words.en: Headaches are pains in your head that can make you feel uncomfortable and can be caused by various factors such as stress, illness, or tension.

words.tr: phrase. 呼吸问题和哮喘发作
words.ex: He has respiratory issues and often gets asthma attacks.
words.ex_cn: 他有呼吸问题，经常发生哮喘发作。
words.en: Respiratory issues and asthma attacks refer to problems related to breathing and sudden worsening of asthma symptoms.

words.tr: phrase. 健康问题；健康方面的困扰或疾病
words.ex: He has health issues because he eats too much junk food.
words.ex_cn: 他因为吃太多垃圾食品而有健康问题。
words.en: Health issues refer to problems related to the condition of the body or mind, often requiring medical attention or affecting one's well-being.

words.tr: v. 毒害；下毒；“poison”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 中毒的；
words.ex: The water was poisoned by chemicals.
words.ex_cn: 水被化学物质毒害了。
words.en: If someone is poisoned, they have been given poison or exposed to something harmful that can cause illness or death.

words.tr: phrase. 患有疾病；遭受病痛
words.ex: He suffered from a sickness last winter.
words.ex_cn: 他去年冬天患了病。

words.ex: People under the age of 18 cannot vote.
words.ex_cn: 18岁以下的人不能投票。

words.ex: Young people like to use smartphones.
words.ex_cn: 年轻人喜欢使用智能手机。
words.en: Young people are individuals in the early stages of life, typically characterized by their energy, potential, and the challenges they face in growing up.

words.ex: The village was snowbound for three days.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄被雪困住了三天。
words.en: If a place or person is snowbound, they are unable to travel because there is so much snow.

words.tr: phrase. 严酷的冬天；寒冷刺骨的冬季
words.ex: The animals struggled to survive the harsh winter.
words.ex_cn: 动物们努力在严酷的冬天中生存。
words.en: A harsh winter is a winter season that is unusually cold, severe, or difficult.

words.ex: He is a doctor or physician who helps sick people.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名医生，帮助生病的人。
words.en: A medical professional who diagnoses and treats illnesses and injuries.

words.ex: His profession is a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他的职业是教师。
words.en: A profession is a type of job that requires advanced education or training.

words.tr:
adj. 红的；
n. 红色；
words.ex: The apple is red.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果是红的。
words.en: Red is the colour of blood or of ripe tomatoes.

words.tr: adj. 带…色的；有色的； v. “color”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The sky turned coloured with orange and pink at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 日落时，天空呈现出橙色和粉色。
words.en: Coloured is used to describe something that has color or is not black and white.

words.ex: Deer or squirrels run fast in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 鹿或松鼠在森林里跑得很快。
words.en: Animals such as deer or squirrels, often referring to wildlife.

words.ex: The houses near the park are small.
words.ex_cn: 公园附近的房子很小。
words.en: A building for human habitation, especially one that is lived in by a family or small group of people.

words.tr: n. 建筑物；楼房； v. 建筑；“build”的现在分词；
words.ex: The tall building has 20 floors.
words.ex_cn: 这栋高楼有20层。
words.en: A building is a structure that has a roof and walls and stands more or less permanently in one place.

words.ex: He makes stir fries with vegetables and chicken.
words.ex_cn: 他用蔬菜和鸡肉做炒菜。
words.en: A dish made by frying small pieces of meat, fish, or vegetables quickly in hot oil while stirring.

words.tr: 意大利调味饭（肉汤加干酪等制成）（risotto 的名词复数）
words.ex: He cooks risottos every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都做意大利烩饭。
words.en: An Italian dish made from rice cooked in broth to a creamy consistency, typically with added ingredients such as cheese, vegetables, or meat.

words.ex: He eats pasta for dinner every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上吃意大利面。
words.en: Pasta is a type of food made from a mixture of flour, eggs, and water that is formed into different shapes and then boiled.

words.ex: She uses different recipes for each meal.
words.ex_cn: 她为每顿饭使用不同的食谱。
words.en: Various methods or sets of instructions for preparing food.

words.tr: n. 帆布背包( rucksack的名词复数 )
words.ex: The children carry their books in rucksacks.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们用帆布背包背着书。
words.en: A rucksack is a bag that you carry on your back, especially when you are walking or climbing.

words.ex: She carries her books in bags.
words.ex_cn: 她把书放在包里。
words.en: A bag is a container made of flexible material with an opening at the top, used for carrying things.

words.ex: Many children suffer from poverty in poor countries.
words.ex_cn: 许多孩子在贫穷国家遭受贫困。
words.en: Poverty is the state of being extremely poor.

words.tr: phrase. 社会问题；指影响社会成员福祉、引发公共关注与讨论的议题，如贫困、教育不平等、种族歧视等
words.ex: He talks about social issues in his class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课堂上谈论社会问题。
words.en: Social issues are matters which directly or indirectly affect many or all members of a society and are considered to be problems, controversies related to moral values, or both.

words.ex: He is interacting with the public at the library.
words.ex_cn: 他正在图书馆与公众互动。
words.en: Communicating or engaging directly with members of the general public.

words.ex: He spoke in a polite manner.
words.ex_cn: 他以礼貌的方式说话。
words.en: The way in which something is done or happens.

words.ex: Many people go to theatres to watch plays.
words.ex_cn: 许多人去剧院看戏剧。
words.en: Theatres are buildings or outdoor areas where plays and other dramatic performances are given.

words.ex: Watching movies is a popular entertainment.
words.ex_cn: 看电影是一种流行的休闲娱乐。
words.en: Entertainment refers to performances or activities that are intended to amuse or interest an audience.

words.tr:
prep. 在…周围；环绕；
adv. 环绕；附近；
adj. 圆的；十足的；
n. 回合；圆形物；
v. 拐过；使成圆形；
words.ex: The children sat round the fire.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们围坐在火堆旁。
words.en: Something that is round is shaped like a circle or a ball.

words.tr:
n. 平方；广场；正方形；四方形；
adj. 正方形的；四方形的；平方的；成直角的；
v. 与...一致；
adv. 成直角地；
words.ex: The area of the room is 16 square.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间的面积是16平方米。
words.en: A square is a shape with four sides of equal length and four angles of 90 degrees. It can also refer to an open area in a town, often used for public events, or to the result of multiplying a number by itself.

words.ex: The pizza was cut into a triangular shape.
words.ex_cn: 比萨被切成三角形。
words.en: Something that is triangular has three straight sides and three angles, or is shaped like a triangle.

words.tr: adj. 六边形的；六角形的
words.ex: The honeycomb is made of hexagonal cells.
words.ex_cn: 蜂巢由六边形的细胞组成。
words.en: Having six sides and six angles.

words.ex: The children sorted blocks into different shapes.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们把积木按不同的形状分类。

words.ex: Researchers study how plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 研究人员研究植物如何生长。
words.en: People who carry out academic or scientific research.

words.ex: He burns coal to keep his house warm.
words.ex_cn: 他烧煤来让房子暖和。
words.en: Coal is a hard black substance that is extracted from the ground and burned as fuel.

words.ex: The country exports oil and natural gas to other nations.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家向其他国家出口石油和天然气。
words.en: Fossil fuels extracted from the earth, used for energy and as raw materials for various products.

words.tr: n. 传统燃料（如煤炭、石油、天然气等）
words.ex: Many cars still use traditional fuels like gasoline.
words.ex_cn: 许多汽车仍然使用汽油等传统燃料。
words.en: Conventional energy sources like coal, oil, and gas, as opposed to renewable alternatives.

words.ex: The librarian helps students find books.
words.ex_cn: 图书管理员帮助学生找书。
words.en: A librarian is a person who is in charge of a library or who has been trained to do this work.

words.ex: The school supporting staff clean the classrooms and help students with lunch.
words.ex_cn: 学校辅助人员打扫教室并帮助学生吃午饭。

words.ex: A camel can go for a long time without water.
words.ex_cn: 一只骆驼可以长时间不喝水。
words.en: A large, even-toed ungulate (Camelus) with a humped back, adapted to desert travel and carrying heavy loads.

words.ex: I saw a panda at the zoo.
words.ex_cn: 我在动物园看到一只熊猫。

words.ex: I saw a lion and a tiger at the zoo.
words.ex_cn: 我在动物园看到了一头狮子和一头老虎。

words.ex: The children love to see animals at the zoo.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢在动物园看动物。
words.en: Animals are living creatures such as dogs, lions, and dolphins. They are not plants, and they can usually move around and react to their surroundings.

words.w: boys and girls in local schools
words.tr: phrase. 当地学校里的男孩和女孩
words.ex: Boys and girls in local schools play together at recess.
words.ex_cn: 当地学校里的男孩和女孩在课间一起玩耍。

words.ex: The local school children walk to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 本地中小学生每天早上步行上学。

words.ex: Do you want vegetables or meat for dinner?
words.ex_cn: 晚餐你想要蔬菜还是肉？

words.tr: n. 材料；组成部分；“ingredient”的复数；
words.ex: The recipe lists all the ingredients you need.
words.ex_cn: 这个食谱列出了你需要的所有材料。
words.en: The ingredients of something are the things that are used to make it, especially in cooking.

words.ex: The museum displays many old paintings.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆展出了许多古老的绘画。
words.en: Paintings are pictures that are made using paint.

words.ex: The museum has many sculptures and artefacts.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆有许多雕塑和工艺品。

words.ex: The museum displayed many beautiful artworks.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆展出了许多精美的艺术品。
words.en: Artwork refers to the pieces of art that are produced by artists, including paintings, sculptures, and other forms of visual art.

words.ex: She placed the cutlery neatly on the table.
words.ex_cn: 她把餐具整齐地放在桌子上。
words.en: Cutlery refers to the tools used for eating or serving food, such as knives, forks, and spoons.

words.ex: We use knives and forks to eat dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我们用刀叉吃晚饭。
words.en: Knives and forks are utensils used for eating, with knives typically used for cutting and forks for spearing food.

words.tr: phrase. 疾病；健康状况；医学病症
words.ex: He has a medical condition that needs care.
words.ex_cn: 他有一种需要护理的疾病。
words.en: A medical condition is a broad term that includes all diseases and disorders that affect health.

words.ex: He wants to study medicine at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习医学。
words.en: Medicine is the science or practice of the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of disease.

words.ex: There are 38 people in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 教室里有38个人。
words.en: People are men, women, and children. People is often used to refer to a large group of people, especially when their exact number is not known or not important.

words.ex: Consumers and designers work together to create new products.
words.ex_cn: 消费者和设计师共同创造新产品。

words.ex: He bought a new device to take photos.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一个新设备来拍照。
words.en: A device is an object or machine that has been invented for a particular purpose.

words.ex: I need a computer or laptop for my work.
words.ex_cn: 我需要一台电脑或笔记本电脑用于我的工作。

words.ex: The store sells all kinds of footwear.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售各种鞋类。
words.en: Footwear refers to garments worn on the feet, which typically serve the purpose of protection against adversities of the environment such as ground textures and temperature.

words.ex: He wore heavy boots to walk in the snow.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了厚重的靴子在雪地里走路。
words.en: Boots are a type of footwear that covers the foot and extends up the leg, sometimes to the knee or even the hip. They are typically made of leather or rubber and are worn for protection against cold, wet, or rugged terrain.

words.ex: She is not just smart but also kind.
words.ex_cn: 她不仅聪明，而且善良。

words.ex: He likes apples, but also oranges.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果，也喜欢橙子。
words.en: A conjunction used to add a second, related point to a previous statement.

words.ex: Both my sister and my brother like ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 我妹妹和我弟弟都喜欢冰淇淋。
words.en: Used to emphasize that two or more things or qualities are true or exist.

words.tr: phrase. 与...在一起；沿着；除此之外，还…
words.ex: He bought apples along with oranges.
words.ex_cn: 他买了苹果，还买了橙子。
words.en: in addition to someone or something else; together with someone or something else

words.ex: He can play the guitar as well as sing.
words.ex_cn: 他既能弹吉他也能唱歌。
words.en: In addition to; and also; equally with.

words.ex: I like tea or coffee.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢茶或者咖啡。
words.en: You use or to link two or more alternatives.

words.tr:
adj. 又一个的；另一个的；
pron. 又一；另一；
words.ex: I need another cup of tea.
words.ex_cn: 我需要又一杯茶。
words.en: used to refer to an additional person or thing of the same type as one already mentioned or known about.

words.ex: I like apples, and I also like oranges.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢苹果，我也喜欢橙子。
words.en: You use also to give more information about something or to add another relevant fact.

words.ex: I like apples and oranges.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢苹果和橙子。
words.en: Used to connect words of the same part of speech, clauses, or sentences, that are to be taken jointly.

words.ex: The accident was caused by bad weather.
words.ex_cn: 这场事故是由恶劣天气引起的。
words.en: To be the reason why something, especially something bad, happens.

words.tr:
n. 原因；理由；理性；
v. 推理；推断；
words.ex: The reason for his absence is sickness.
words.ex_cn: 他缺席的原因是生病。
words.en: A reason is an explanation or justification for an action, belief, or occurrence.

words.ex: He was late due to traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他因为交通堵塞迟到了。
words.en: If an event is due to something, it happens or exists as a direct result of that thing.

words.ex: Why did you come late?
words.ex_cn: 你为什么来晚了？
words.en: You use why in questions when you ask about the reasons for something.

words.ex: The main causes of pollution are cars and factories.
words.ex_cn: 污染的主要原因是汽车和工厂。
words.en: The primary or most significant reasons for something.

words.tr:
adv. 如同；和…一样
prep. 作为；如同
conj. 由于；像；当…时；尽管
words.ex: He runs as fast as a cheetah.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得像猎豹一样快。
words.en: used to compare two things, to show that they are similar in some way; used to introduce the reason for something; used to mean 'in the role of'

words.ex: He was late because the bus was slow.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，因为公交车很慢。
words.en: You use 'because' when stating the reason for something.

words.tr:
adv. 如此；这么；很；也
conj. 所以
words.ex: I am so tired after school.
words.ex_cn: 我放学后非常累。
words.en: used to emphasize the degree or extent of something

words.ex: He was late because of the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他因为公交车而迟到了。
words.en: You use 'because of' to introduce the reason or explanation for something.

words.tr: phrase. 一个重要的因素；在某种情况或结果中起重要作用的要素
words.ex: Sleep is a significant factor in learning.
words.ex_cn: 睡眠是学习的一个重要因素。
words.en: A significant factor is an important element or aspect that contributes to a particular result or situation.

words.ex: Rain can affect the crop growth.
words.ex_cn: 雨水会影响作物生长。
words.en: To have an influence on or cause a change in someone or something.

words.ex: My bag is similar to yours.
words.ex_cn: 我的包与你的包相似。

words.ex: He got the highest score in the class.
words.ex_cn: 他得了班上最高的分数。
words.en: Of the greatest or most extreme degree or amount.

words.ex: He is the tallest boy in his class.
words.ex_cn: 他是班上最高的男孩。

words.ex: He is as tall as his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他和他的哥哥一样高。
words.en: A comparative structure used to show equality in degree or amount between two things.

words.ex: He runs just like his father.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步就像他父亲一样。
words.en: In the same way as; similar to.

words.ex: This book is similar to the one I read last week.
words.ex_cn: 这本书和我上周读的那本很相似。
words.en: resembling or alike; having qualities in common.

words.ex: This box is larger than that one.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子比那个大。
words.en: Of considerable or great size or extent.

words.ex: This box is bigger than that one.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子比那个大。
words.en: Comparative form of big: larger in size, amount, or degree than something else.

words.tr: 远不如……显眼；远不如……可见
words.ex: The moon is not nearly as visible as the sun during the day.
words.ex_cn: 白天，月亮没有太阳那么明显。
words.en: Far less noticeable or prominent than something else.

words.ex: The problem is less visible now.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题现在较不明显了。

words.ex: She is tall compared to her brother.
words.ex_cn: 她和她哥哥相比很高。
words.en: Used when you are comparing two things or people, in order to show the differences between them.

words.ex: The two dogs are similar in color.
words.ex_cn: 这两只狗的颜色很相似。
words.en: If one thing is similar to another, or if two things are similar, they have features that are the same.

words.ex: That was the scariest movie I've ever seen.
words.ex_cn: 那是我看过的最可怕的电影。
words.en: Superlative form of 'scary', meaning the most frightening or causing the most fear.

words.ex: The most frightening sound was the loud scream in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 最可怕的声音是黑暗中传出的尖叫声。

words.tr: v. 类似于；像…，类似于( resemble的现在分词 )；
words.ex: The cat resembles a small tiger.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫类似于一只小老虎。
words.en: similar in appearance or nature; having qualities or features that are alike

words.ex: He runs like a cheetah.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得像猎豹一样。
words.en: To find something enjoyable or agreeable; to have a positive feeling towards someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. & adv. 当我还是小孩子的时候（用于引导时间状语从句或作时间状语）
words.ex: When I was little, I used to be afraid of the dark.
words.ex_cn: phrase. 当我小时候，我害怕黑暗。
words.en: phrase. Refers to the time when the speaker was a child.

words.ex: He remembers his childhood as a happy time.
words.ex_cn: 他记得自己的童年是一段快乐的时光。
words.en: Childhood is the period of a person's life when they are a child.

words.ex: It is possible to learn English quickly.
words.ex_cn: 快速学会英语是可能的。
words.en: If something is possible, it can be done or achieved.

words.tr:
n. 潜力；
adj. 潜在的；
words.ex: The young athlete shows great potential.
words.ex_cn: 这位年轻运动员展现出巨大的潜力。
words.en: If you say that someone or something has potential, you mean that they have the necessary abilities or qualities to become successful or useful in the future.

words.ex: I am going to eat lunch now.
words.ex_cn: 我打算现在吃午饭。
words.en: Used to express a future action, intention, or prediction.

words.tr: 用于表示将来时态，表示即将做某事或打算做某事，相当于“将要”或“打算”
words.ex: They are going to eat dinner now.
words.ex_cn: 他们马上要吃晚饭了。
words.en: A verb phrase indicating a future action or intention.

words.tr:
auxv. 将会；愿意；
n. 意志；意愿；遗嘱；
words.ex: I will go to the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天会去公园。
words.en: The word 'will' can be used as a noun to refer to the faculty by which a person decides on and initiates action, or as a verb to indicate a desire or intention to do something.

words.ex: He read a historical book about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 他读了一本关于古罗马的历史书。
words.en: Historical means relating to the study of history or connected with the past.

words.ex: At present, he is working as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 目前，他是一名老师。
words.en: At the present time; now.

words.ex: He was tired, but he will study later on.
words.ex_cn: 他很累，但他稍后会学习。
words.en: At a time in the future; after the time you are talking about.

words.ex: He made a permanent change to his lifestyle.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的生活方式做出了永久的改变。
words.en: Something that is permanent exists or happens all the time, or exists for a long time without changing.

words.ex: The castle is a medieval building.
words.ex_cn: 这座城堡是一座中世纪的建筑。
words.en: Relating to the Middle Ages, the period in European history from about the 5th century to the 15th century.

words.ex: The old man walks slowly in the park.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人在公园里慢慢走路。
words.en: Having lived or existed for a long time; no longer young or new.

words.tr:
adj. 当前的；流通的；
n. （水、气、电）流；趋势；
words.ex: The current weather is very hot.
words.ex_cn: 当前的天气非常热。
words.en: belonging to the present time; happening or being used or done now

words.ex: The nineteenth-century architecture is a key feature of the city's landscape.
words.ex_cn: 十九世纪的建筑是这座城市景观的一个关键特征。
words.en: Belonging to or characteristic of the 19th century.

words.ex: He visited Paris last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年去了巴黎。
words.en: The year before the current one.

words.ex: He played soccer in the past.
words.ex_cn: 他过去踢足球。
words.en: At a time before the present; in earlier times.

words.ex: I ate breakfast this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我今天早上吃了早餐。
words.en: The period of time between midnight and noon on the current day.

words.tr:
conj. 在…的时候；
adv. 什么时候；
words.ex: I eat breakfast when I wake up.
words.ex_cn: 我醒来的时候吃早餐。
words.en: You use when to ask about the time that something happened or will happen.

words.tr: phrase. 持续如此之久；继续这么长时间
words.ex: The movie will go on for so long that some people fall asleep.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影持续时间太长，有些人睡着了。
words.en: To continue for an extended period of time.

words.tr: adj. 持久的；持续的；长期的
words.ex: This paint is long-lasting and doesn't fade easily.
words.ex_cn: 这种油漆持久不褪色。
words.en: Something that is long-lasting continues to exist or have an effect for a long time.

words.ex: In recent years, more people use smartphones.
words.ex_cn: 近年来，更多人使用智能手机。
words.en: During the last few years.

words.ex: These days, children use tablets to learn.
words.ex_cn: 如今，孩子们用平板电脑学习。
words.en: at the present time; nowadays

words.ex: He wakes up at a particular time every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在一个特定的时间醒来。
words.en: At a specific, agreed, or usual time.

words.ex: At a given time, only one person can use the computer.
words.ex_cn: 在特定时间，只有一个人能使用电脑。
words.en: At a specific moment or period.

words.ex: He was busy at the moment.
words.ex_cn: 当时他很忙。
words.en: At the moment is used to indicate that something is happening now.

words.tr: adj. 仅几天大的；出生才几天的
words.ex: The puppy is only a few days old.
words.ex_cn: 这只小狗只有几天大。
words.en: Having existed or been alive for only a short period of time.

words.w: will be here for ten weeks only
words.tr: phrase. 只会在这里待十周

words.w: on show for a limited time
words.ex: The painting is on show for a limited time at the museum.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画在博物馆限时展出。

words.tr:
adv. 在今天；当今；
n. 今天；当今；
words.ex: I will finish my homework today.
words.ex_cn: 我今天会完成我的作业。
words.en: This day, as distinct from yesterday or tomorrow.

words.ex: This house has a modern design.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子具有现代的设计。
words.en: Modern means relating to the present time, for example the present decade or present century.

words.ex: The prospect of a better job makes him happy.
words.ex_cn: 更好工作的前景让他感到高兴。
words.en: A prospect is the possibility that something will happen, or a view of a wide area.

words.tr:
n. 未来；将来；前途；
adj. 将来的；未来的；
words.ex: We cannot predict the future.
words.ex_cn: 我们无法预测未来。
words.en: The future is the time after the present, or the events that will happen then.

words.ex: I am eating now.
words.ex_cn: 我现在正在吃饭。
words.en: at the present time or moment

words.ex: I recently bought a new book.
words.ex_cn: 我最近买了一本新书。
words.en: If something happened recently, it happened only a short time ago.

words.ex: He read the most recent news about the election.
words.ex_cn: 他阅读了关于选举的最新新闻。
words.en: Happening or existing at the most recent time.

words.tr: phrase. 最后的；最终的；上一个的
words.ex: He was the last to leave the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 他是最后一个离开教室的人。
words.en: Coming after all others in time, order, or importance; final.

words.ex: Initially, he didn't like the job.
words.ex_cn: 最初，他不喜欢这份工作。
words.en: At the beginning; at first.

words.tr:
adj. 最初的；开始的；
n. 首字母；
words.ex: This is the initial plan for the project.
words.ex_cn: 这是这个项目的最初计划。
words.en: The first letter of a name or word, used to represent the whole name or word.

words.ex: At first, he did not like math.
words.ex_cn: 起初，他不喜欢数学。
words.en: At the beginning; initially.

words.tr: phrase. 开始做某事（begin 的过去式）
words.ex: He began to walk to school.
words.ex_cn: 他开始走路去学校。
words.en: Started to do something or entered a state of action.

words.tr: phrase. 世界上的第一个（事物或成就）
words.ex: He invented the world's first computer.
words.ex_cn: 他发明了世界上第一台计算机。
words.en: The very first instance of its kind in the world.

words.tr: v. 发明；编造； n. 发明，创造( invent的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He invented a new machine to help clean the house.
words.ex_cn: 他发明了一台新机器来帮助打扫房子。
words.en: To invent something means to design and/or create something which has never been made before.

words.ex: Originally, he wanted to be a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 起初，他想当一名老师。
words.en: Initially; in the first place; in a novel or inventive manner.

words.ex: He will finish school on the last day of June.
words.ex_cn: 他将在六月的最后一天结束学业。
words.en: The final day of a specific period or event.

words.ex: The end of support for this software is approaching.
words.ex_cn: 这款软件的支持期限即将结束。
words.en: The point in time or space at which something ceases to exist or to continue.

words.tr: v. 开始；创建；“begin”的过去式；
words.ex: He began to walk to school.
words.ex_cn: 他开始走路去学校。
words.en: Began is the past tense of begin. To begin means to start doing something.

words.tr:
v. 开始；
n. 开始；
words.ex: He starts his day with coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他以喝咖啡开始一天。
words.en: To begin doing something; to cause something to begin or to operate; to set out on a journey.

words.tr:
adj. 最新的；最后的；最近的；
n. 最新事物；
words.ex: He bought the latest phone on the market.
words.ex_cn: 他买了市场上最新的手机。
words.en: The most recent or the newest.

words.ex: He bought a new bike yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天买了一辆新自行车。
words.en: Recently made, invented, introduced, or discovered; not existing before.

words.ex: To begin with, we need to clean the room.
words.ex_cn: 首先，我们需要打扫房间。
words.en: As a first point or reason; initially.

words.tr: v. 开始；“start”的现在分词； n. 开始；出发；
words.ex: He is starting his homework now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在开始做作业。
words.en: Starting refers to the act of beginning something, such as a process, activity, or journey.

words.tr: phrase. 在任何人之前；优先于他人
words.ex: He finished his homework before anyone else.
words.ex_cn: 他在其他人之前完成了作业。
words.en: Earlier in time or order than all other people or things.

words.tr:
adj. 第一的；
adv. 首先；第一；
n. 第一；
words.ex: He got the first prize in the race.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中获得了第一名。
words.en: A fist is the hand with the fingers bent in towards the palm and held tightly there, typically in order to strike a blow or grasp something.

words.w: no stories of that type had been written before
words.tr: phrase. 以前从未有人写过那种类型的故事
words.uk: /nəʊ ˈstɔːriz əv ðæt taɪp hæd biːn rɪtn bɪˈfɔːr/
words.us: /no ˈstoʊriz əv ðæt taɪp hæd biːn rɪtn bɪˈfɔːr/
words.ex: No stories of that type had been written before.
words.ex_cn: 以前从未写过那种类型的故事。
words.en: There were no previous works of that particular kind.

words.tr: 动词短语 开创一种新流派
words.ex: He started a new genre with his music.
words.ex_cn: 他用他的音乐开创了一种新流派。

words.ex: He finished the project ahead of schedule.
words.ex_cn: 他提前完成了项目。
words.en: If something is done ahead of schedule, it is done before the time that was planned.

words.ex: He smiled for the first time today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天第一次笑了。
words.en: If something happens for the first time, it has never happened before.

words.ex: Firstly, we need to clean the room.
words.ex_cn: 首先，我们需要打扫房间。
words.en: You use firstly in speech or writing when you want to give a reason, make a point, or mention an item that will be followed by others connected with it.

words.tr:
prep. 在…之前；先于；
conj. 在…以前；
adv. 以前；之前；
words.ex: She ate breakfast before school.
words.ex_cn: 她在上学之前吃了早餐。
words.en: Earlier in time; previously.

words.ex: Please pay in advance.
words.ex_cn: 请提前付款。
words.en: Before a particular time, or before doing a particular thing.

words.ex: Quite a few students passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 相当多的学生通过了考试。
words.en: You use quite a few to emphasize that you are referring to a considerable number of things or people.

words.tr:
adj. 特指的；特殊的；挑剔的；
n. 细节；详情；
words.ex: He wants a particular book, not any other.
words.ex_cn: 他想要一本特指的书，不是别的。
words.en: You use particular to emphasize that you are talking about one thing or one kind of thing rather than other similar ones.

words.tr: art. 一个 （在下一单词为元音开头时代替“a”）
words.ex: I saw an apple on the table.
words.ex_cn: 我看到桌子上有一个苹果。
words.en: Used before a word that begins with a vowel sound.

words.tr: phrase. 大量的样本；大量的样品
words.ex: The scientist tested a large sample of water from the river.
words.ex_cn: 科学家测试了来自这条河的大批水样。
words.en: A large number or amount of something.

words.ex: There is plenty of food on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌上有很多食物。
words.en: A large quantity or number; more than enough.

words.tr:
pron. 几个；一些；
adj. 不同的；
words.ex: I have several books on the table.
words.ex_cn: 我桌上放着几本书。
words.en: Several means a number of people or things that is more than a few but not a lot.

words.ex: There are more than 2000 students in the school.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校有超过2000名学生。
words.en: A quantity greater than two thousand.

words.tr: adv. 仅仅；就；只是；刚刚；恰好；
words.ex: He just wants to sleep.
words.ex_cn: 他仅仅想睡觉。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is exactly the case or is happening at this moment.

words.tr:
adv. 只；仅仅；只有；
adj. 唯一的；仅有的；
words.ex: He eats only apples for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐只吃苹果。
words.en: You use only to indicate the one thing that is true, appropriate, or important in a particular situation, in contrast to all the other things that are not true, appropriate, or important.

words.ex: He has a considerable amount of money.
words.ex_cn: 他有相当多的钱。
words.en: Considerable means large in size, amount, or extent.

words.ex: He is mostly late for class.
words.ex_cn: 他主要迟到上课。
words.en: You use mostly to indicate that a statement is generally true, for example true about most of a group of things or people, true most of the time, or true in most situations.

words.tr: phrase. 几乎全部；差不多所有
words.ex: Almost all of the students passed the exam.
words.ex_cn: 几乎所有的学生都通过了考试。
words.en: Nearly every one; the vast majority.

words.tr:
adj. 许多的；
pron. 许多人或物；
words.ex: Many students like to play soccer after school.
words.ex_cn: 许多学生喜欢放学后踢足球。
words.en: A large number of.

words.tr: phrase. 大量地；散装地；成批地
words.ex: He buys apples in bulk to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他批量购买苹果以节省金钱。
words.en: In large quantities or amounts, not divided into separate units.

words.tr:
adj. 大规模的；大量的；
n. 大量；质量；块；群；团；
words.ex: The company launched a mass production line to meet demand.
words.ex_cn: 该公司启动了大规模生产线以满足需求。
words.en: A mass is a large amount of something that has no particular shape or arrangement.

words.tr: phrase. 大量的；大批的；许多的
words.ex: He bought large quantities of rice for the party.
words.ex_cn: 他为聚会买了大量的大米。
words.en: A large amount or number of something.

words.ex: He has a lot of books.
words.ex_cn: 他有很多书。
words.en: A large number or amount of something.

words.ex: He drinks two litres of water every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天喝两升水。
words.en: A litre is a metric unit of capacity, formerly defined as the volume of one kilogram of water under standard conditions, now equal to 1,000 cubic centimetres (about 1.75 pints).

words.ex: A huge quantity of water was wasted.
words.ex_cn: 数量巨大的水被浪费了。

words.tr:
adv. 更加；
adj. 更多的；
pron. 更多的人或物；
words.ex: She wants to learn more about science.
words.ex_cn: 她想更深入了解科学。
words.en: You use 'more' to indicate that there is a greater amount of something than before or than average, or than something else. You can use 'more' with a noun to indicate that there is a greater amount of it than before or than average, or than something else.

words.tr: adj. 较大的；程度较重的；
words.ex: This box is greater than that one.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子比那个大。
words.en: You use greater to indicate that something is larger in size, degree, or importance than something else.

words.ex: The number of students is increasing.
words.ex_cn: 学生的人数在增加。
words.en: The phrase 'the number of' refers to the quantity or count of something, typically used to indicate how many of a particular thing there are.

words.ex: He bought a pair of shoes.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一双鞋。
words.en: used to describe two things that are the same or similar and are meant to be used together

words.tr: phrase. 成对地；两人一组地；成双地
words.ex: The students were asked to work in pairs.
words.ex_cn: 学生们被要求成对地工作。
words.en: In twos; two at a time.

words.w: only enough for your own needs
words.tr: adj. 仅够满足自身需求的
words.uk: ˈəʊnli ɪˈnʌf fɔː jɔːr əʊn niːdz
words.us: ˈoʊnli ɪˈnʌf fɔːr jʊr oʊn nidz
words.ex: She has only enough for her own needs.
words.ex_cn: 她只有刚好够自己需要的量。
words.en: Sufficient only to meet one's personal requirements.

words.tr: 短语：少量的；有限数量的
words.ex: He has a limited amount of money to buy food.
words.ex_cn: 他只有有限的钱来买食物。
words.en: A small quantity or number of something.

words.tr: phrase. 如此多的（用于修饰可数名词复数）
words.ex: There are so many books on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书架上有这么多书。
words.en: Used to emphasize a large number of things or people.

words.ex: There is a rise in prices this month.
words.ex_cn: 这个月物价上涨了。
words.en: An increase in the level, amount, or degree of something.

words.tr: 短语。比以往任何时候都更多（某物）；比以前更甚
words.ex: People are using phones more of them than ever.
words.ex_cn: 人们现在使用的手机比以往任何时候都多。
words.en: A greater amount of something than at any previous time.

words.tr:
n. 上升；提高；
v. 上升；提高；
words.ex: There was a rise in temperature yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天温度上升了。
words.en: If an amount or level rises, it increases; if something rises, it moves upwards; if you rise, you stand up; if you rise, you get out of bed.

words.tr: v. 没有足够的（某物）；不足
words.ex: He does not have enough money to buy the book.
words.ex_cn: 他没有足够的钱买这本书。
words.en: To lack a sufficient quantity or amount.

words.tr:
adj. 很少；不多；
pron. 很少人；一些；
n. 几个；
words.ex: Few people came to the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 很少有人来参加会议。
words.en: A few means a small number of things or people. When you say there are a few of something, you mean there are not many of them.

words.tr: adj. 单一的；单独的；单身的；
words.ex: He bought a single ticket for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一张单程公交车票。
words.en: Only one in number; one only; not married or not involved in a stable romantic relationship.

words.ex: I have one apple.
words.ex_cn: 我有一个苹果。
words.en: One is used to refer to the first and lowest whole number, often used to indicate a single person or thing.

words.ex: The majority of students like pizza.
words.ex_cn: 大多数学生喜欢披萨。
words.en: The majority is the greater number or part of something.

words.ex: There is a multitude of birds in the park.
words.ex_cn: 公园里有大量鸟类。
words.en: A multitude of things or people is a very large number of them.

words.tr: adj. 各种各样的；不同的；各种的；
words.ex: He bought various fruits at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了各种各样的水果。
words.en: If you say that there are various things, you mean there are several different things of the type mentioned.

words.tr:
adj. 全部的；
adv. 全部地；
n. 全部；
words.ex: All the students passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 所有学生都通过了考试。
words.en: All is used to indicate that every part of something or every one of a group is included or involved.

words.ex: He completely forgot his keys.
words.ex_cn: 他完全忘记了钥匙。
words.en: In a way that is whole or entire; to the fullest extent.

words.ex: There are various types of flowers in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 花园里有各种类型的花。

words.tr: phrase. + n. 不同种类的；各种各样的
words.ex: There are different kinds of fruits in the market.
words.ex_cn: 市场上有不同种类的水果。
words.en: phrase. various types or categories of something

words.tr:
adj. 一些；某些；
pron. 有些；若干；
words.ex: I need some water.
words.ex_cn: 我需要一些水。
words.en: used to refer to an unspecified amount or number of something

words.ex: A number of students are late for class.
words.ex_cn: 许多学生上课迟到了。
words.en: An indefinite but considerable amount or quantity of something.

words.ex: The scarcity of water caused problems in the village.
words.ex_cn: 水的缺乏给村庄带来了问题。
words.en: A scarcity of something is a situation in which there is not enough of it.

words.tr:
n. 缺乏；短缺；
v. 缺乏；短缺；
words.ex: There is a lack of clean water in the village.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄缺乏干净的水。
words.en: If there is a lack of something, there is not enough of it or it does not exist at all.

words.ex: This painting has a distinctive style.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画有独特的风格。
words.en: Something that is distinctive has a special quality or feature which makes it easily recognizable and different from other things of the same type.

words.ex: This painting is unique because no other like it exists.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是独特的，因为没有其他类似的。
words.en: Something that is unique is the only one of its kind.

words.ex: The government took a number of measures to improve the environment.
words.ex_cn: 政府采取了一系列措施来改善环境。

words.ex: There are various ways to solve this problem.
words.ex_cn: 解决这个问题有多种方法。
words.en: Different methods or approaches to achieve something.

words.ex: He eats apples every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃苹果。
words.en: Each and all of the members of a group or set without exception.

words.tr:
adj. 每个的；各自的；
pron. 每个；各自；
words.ex: Each student has a book.
words.ex_cn: 每个学生都有一本书。
words.en: Used to refer to every one of a group or series considered individually.

words.ex: I like all fruits, especially apples.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢所有的水果，尤其是苹果。
words.en: You use especially to emphasize that what you are saying applies more to one thing or situation than to others.

words.tr: phrase. 大范围的；范围广泛的
words.ex: The store has a wide range of toys for children.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店有各种各样的儿童玩具。
words.en: A wide range of means there is a large variety or a great number of different things within a particular category.

words.tr: phrase. 很多的；丰富的；大量的
words.ex: He has a wealth of experience in teaching English.
words.ex_cn: 他有丰富的英语教学经验。
words.en: A large amount of something valuable or useful.

words.tr: phrase. 不慢的；迅速的；敏捷的
words.ex: He is not slow in making decisions.
words.ex_cn: 他做决定很快。
words.en: Moving, happening, or doing something at high speed; not taking a lot of time.

words.w: in a relatively short space of time
words.tr: phrase. phr. 在相对较短的时间内
words.uk: ɪn ə ˈrelətɪvli ʃɔːt speɪs əv taɪm
words.us: ɪn ə ˈrelətɪvli ʃɔːrt speɪs əv taɪm
words.ex: He learned to swim in a relatively short space of time.
words.ex_cn: 他在相对较短的时间内学会了游泳。
words.en: In a relatively short space of time means that something happens or is achieved over a period that is considered short compared to what might be expected or usual.

words.ex: The car moved at a rapid speed.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车以迅速的速度行驶。
words.en: A rapid change or event happens very quickly.

words.tr:
adv. 迅速；
adj. 快的；迅速的；
words.ex: He runs fast.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快。
words.en: Moving or capable of moving at high speed.

words.w: be there first thing in the morning
words.uk: bi ðeə fɜːst θɪŋ ɪn ðə ˈmɔːnɪŋ
words.us: bi ðer fɜːrst θɪŋ ɪn ðə ˈmɔːrnɪŋ
words.ex: I will be there first thing in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 我一大早就到那里。
words.en: To arrive at a location at the very start of the day.

words.tr: 短语动词. 尽早到达那里；提前抵达目的地
words.ex: We will get there early to find good seats.
words.ex_cn: 我们会早点到那里找好座位。
words.en: Arrive at a place before the scheduled time to avoid being late.

words.ex: He left the room immediately after the bell rang.
words.ex_cn: 铃声一响，他就立即离开了房间。
words.en: If something happens immediately, it happens without any delay.

words.ex: He will arrive soon.
words.ex_cn: 他很快就会到。
words.en: If something is going to happen soon, it will happen after a short time. If something happened soon after a particular time or event, it happened a short time after it.

words.tr: adj. 即刻的；立即的；紧接的；最近的；
words.ex: He needs immediate help.
words.ex_cn: 他需要即刻的帮助。
words.en: An immediate action, event, or situation happens or exists without any delay.

words.ex: He left straight away after the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议结束后他立刻离开了。
words.en: If you do something straight away, you do it immediately and without delay.

words.tr: 短语. 在短时间内；短期内
words.ex: He learned to swim in a short period.
words.ex_cn: 他在短时间内学会了游泳。
words.en: Within a brief or limited timeframe.

words.ex: He ran quickly to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速跑着去赶公交车。
words.en: In a fast or rapid manner.

words.tr:
pron. 没有什么；
n. 无关紧要的事；
words.ex: I have nothing to say.
words.ex_cn: 我没什么可说的。
words.en: Nothing means not anything or no single thing.

words.ex: I hate waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 我讨厌早起。
words.en: To hate someone or something means to feel intense or passionate dislike for them.

words.tr: abbr. 不要；不；“do not”的缩写
words.ex: Don't touch the hot stove.
words.ex_cn: 不要碰热炉子。
words.en: Don't is the usual spoken form of 'do not'.

words.ex: He doesn't like math.
words.ex_cn: 他不喜欢数学。
words.en: Doesn't is the usual spoken form of 'does not'.

words.ex: He hardly ate anything at dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐几乎没吃东西。
words.en: You use hardly to modify a statement when you want to emphasize that it is only a small amount or degree which is true, or that it is not true at all.

words.ex: There is little water left in the bottle.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里剩下的水很少。
words.en: Small in size, amount, or degree (often used to convey an appealing diminutiveness or express an affectionate or dismissive attitude).

words.ex: They weren't at the party last night.
words.ex_cn: 他们昨晚没在派对上。
words.en: Were not; used to indicate the negative form of 'were'.

words.tr:
v. 禁止；
n. 禁止；
words.ex: The school bans phones in class.
words.ex_cn: 学校禁止在课堂上使用手机。
words.en: If there is a ban on something, it is not allowed. If something is banned, it is not allowed to be done, shown, or used.

words.tr:
adj. 没有；不
adv. 不；不是
words.ex: There is no water in the bottle.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里没有水。
words.en: used to give a negative response or statement

words.ex: He has never been to Japan.
words.ex_cn: 他从未去过日本。
words.en: At no time in the past or future; on no occasion; not ever.

words.ex: He is not happy.
words.ex_cn: 他不开心。
words.en: Used to make a negative statement or to negate a verb, adjective, or other adverb.

words.ex: Little information was available about the new policy.
words.ex_cn: 关于这项新政策，可用的信息很少。
words.en: Very little data or knowledge was accessible.

words.tr: phrase. 所知甚少；几乎一无所知
words.ex: Little was known about the ancient city before the dig.
words.ex_cn: 在发掘之前，人们对这座古城知之甚少。
words.en: A small amount was known about a subject or situation.

words.ex: It is impossible to finish the race in five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 五分钟内完成比赛是不可能的。
words.en: If something is impossible, it cannot be done or cannot happen.

words.ex: He is incapable of solving simple math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他无法解决简单的数学问题。
words.en: If someone is incapable of doing something, they are unable to do it.

words.tr: v. 没有意识到；未察觉（英式拼写为 realise，美式拼写通常为 realize）
words.ex: He don't realise it's wrong.
words.ex_cn: 他没意识到这是错的。
words.en: To fail to be aware of or understand something.

words.ex: They are unaware of the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他们不知道这个错误。

words.tr: phrase. 不喜欢；对…不感兴趣；不热衷于
words.ex: I'm not keen on spicy food.
words.ex_cn: 我对辣的食物不感兴趣。
words.en: If you are not keen on something, you do not like it or are not interested in it.

words.ex: He dislikes eating broccoli.
words.ex_cn: 他不喜欢吃西兰花。
words.en: If you dislike someone or something, you consider them to be unpleasant and do not like them.

words.ex: It doesn't have any algebra.
words.ex_cn: 它没有任何代数。
words.en: It possesses nothing of that kind.

words.ex: There is a lack of water in the desert.
words.ex_cn: 沙漠里缺乏水。
words.en: The absence or deficiency of something needed, wanted, or expected.

words.tr: adj. 不对的；不正确的；不合适的
words.ex: That answer is not right.
words.ex_cn: 那个答案不对。
words.en: Incorrect or unsuitable.

words.tr: adj. 错误的；不正确的；不当的；
words.ex: The answer is wrong.
words.ex_cn: 这个答案是错误的。
words.en: If you say there is something wrong, you mean there is something unsatisfactory about the situation, person, or thing you are talking about.

words.tr: phr. 一事无成；没有取得任何成就
words.ex: He did not achieve anything after working all day.
words.ex_cn: 他忙了一整天，却什么也没达成。
words.en: To fail to accomplish any objective or result.

words.ex: His actions were ineffective to stop the leak.
words.ex_cn: 他的行动未能阻止泄漏。

words.tr: v. 不能访问；无法参观
words.ex: I can't visit my friend because it's raining.
words.ex_cn: 因为下雨，我不能去看我的朋友。
words.en: Unable to visit or go to see someone or a place, often due to distance, circumstances, or restrictions.

words.tr: adj. 关闭的；保密的； v. 关闭；“close”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The store is closed on Sundays.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店星期天关门。
words.en: If something is closed, it is not open or available to the public.

words.ex: It doesn't include breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 它不包括早餐。

words.tr: phrase. 不可获得的；无法得到的；无现货的；不可用的
words.ex: The book is not available in the library.
words.ex_cn: 这本书在图书馆里没有。
words.en: If something is not available, it is not able to be used, obtained, or reached at a particular time.

words.tr: phrase. 不允许的；被禁止的
words.ex: Smoking is not allowed here.
words.ex_cn: 这里不允许吸烟。
words.en: If something is not allowed, it is not permitted or authorized.

words.tr: v. 禁止；妨碍；“prohibit”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: Smoking is prohibited in this building.
words.ex_cn: 在这个建筑里禁止吸烟。
words.en: Officially or legally forbidden.

words.ex: He cannot swim without water.
words.ex_cn: 没有水，他不会游泳。
words.en: If you do something without something else, you do not have that thing with you or you do not use that thing.

words.tr: phrase. + adv. 没有（用于过去时态的否定）
words.ex: He did not go to school yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天没有去学校。
words.en: The past tense of 'do not', used to form the negative of past simple tense verbs.

words.ex: He drank tea instead of coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了茶，而不是咖啡。
words.en: If you do one thing instead of another, you do the first thing and not the second thing, especially as the result of a choice or a change of behaviour.

words.tr: phrase. 宁可 ... 也不愿；与其 ... 倒不如；而不是
words.ex: He chose to walk rather than take the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他宁愿走路也不愿坐公交车。
words.en: used to say that one thing is preferred to another or happens instead of another

words.ex: The park is not very far from my house.
words.ex_cn: 公园离我家不远。
words.en: At a short distance from; nearby.

words.ex: He passed the test by studying hard.
words.ex_cn: 他通过努力学习通过了考试。
words.en: If something is done by a person or thing, that person or thing does it.

words.ex: He bought fresh vegetables from the local market.
words.ex_cn: 他从本地市场买了新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: Something that is local relates to a particular area or to the area where you live.

words.tr: phrase. 有点被压扁的；有点拥挤的；有点变形的
words.ex: The boxes were a bit squashed in the truck.
words.ex_cn: 箱子里在卡车上被压得有点扁。
words.en: Slightly flattened or compressed from its normal shape.

words.ex: The two houses are close together.
words.ex_cn: 这两栋房子挨得很近。
words.en: Positioned very near each other.

words.ex: You can see stars as far away as the edge of the universe.
words.ex_cn: 你可以看到远至宇宙边缘的星星。
words.en: as far away as: (prepositional phrase) At a considerable distance from a specified point or location.

words.tr: adj. 流传甚广的；分布广的；
words.ex: The flu became widespread last winter.
words.ex_cn: 去年冬天流感流传甚广。
words.en: Something that is widespread exists or happens over a large area, or to a great extent.

words.tr: phrase. +pron.+n. 在这个地区；在这一领域；在这一方面
words.ex: He works in this area.
words.ex_cn: 他在这个地区工作。
words.en: Within this particular region or locality.

words.ex: The store sells locally grown vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售本地种植的蔬菜。
words.en: In or referring to a particular area or neighborhood, especially the one where you live or are at the moment.

words.ex: They sat by the lake and watched the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他们坐在湖边看日落。

words.ex: The children play near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在湖边玩耍。
words.en: Located or situated close to a body of water such as a lake.

words.w: people who live in the area
words.tr: n. 居住在该地区的人
words.uk: ˈpiːpl huː lɪv ɪn ðə ˈeəriə
words.us: ˈpiːpl huː lɪv ɪn ðə ˈerɪə
words.ex: The people who live in the area grow their own vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 住在该地区的人们种植自己的蔬菜。

words.tr: phrase. 当地居民；本地住户
words.ex: Local residents walk their dogs in the park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 当地居民每天早上在公园遛狗。
words.en: People who live in a particular area or community.

words.tr: phrase. 不远的；就在附近；近在咫尺
words.ex: The park is not far away from my house.
words.ex_cn: 公园离我家不远。
words.en: At a short distance from a specified point or place.

words.tr:
adj. 附近的；
adv. 在附近；
words.ex: There is a park nearby my house.
words.ex_cn: 我家附近有一个公园。
words.en: If something is nearby, it is only a short distance away.

words.ex: He sat beside his friend on the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在朋友旁边。
words.en: At the side of; next to.

words.ex: The book is next to the pen.
words.ex_cn: 书在笔旁边。
words.en: Adjacent to; at the side of.

words.ex: The cat is close to the box.
words.ex_cn: 猫在盒子旁边。
words.en: Near to someone or something in distance or time.

words.tr:
prep. 靠近；在…附近；
adj. 近的；
adv. 近地；
words.ex: The cat is near the window.
words.ex_cn: 猫靠近窗户。
words.en: If something is near, it is not far away in distance or time.

words.ex: He normally goes to bed at 10 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 他通常晚上10点睡觉。
words.en: If you say that something normally happens or that you normally do a particular thing, you mean that it is what usually happens or what you usually do.

words.ex: He exercises a few times a week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周锻炼几次。
words.en: Occurring or happening on several occasions within a week, indicating regularity.

words.ex: He exercises on a regular basis.
words.ex_cn: 他定期锻炼。
words.en: If something happens on a regular basis, it happens repeatedly, often at fixed times.

words.tr: adv. 定期地；经常地；有规律地；
words.ex: He visits his grandparents regularly.
words.ex_cn: 他定期去看望他的祖父母。
words.en: At consistent intervals or in a consistent manner.

words.tr:
adv. 最；
pron. 大部分；
adj. 最多的；大多数的；
words.ex: He is most tired after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后最累。
words.en: You use most to refer to the majority of a group of things or people or the largest part of something.

words.ex: He mainly eats vegetables and fruit.
words.ex_cn: 他主要吃蔬菜和水果。
words.en: You use mainly to indicate that a statement is true in most cases or to a large extent.

words.ex: I like fruits, particularly apples.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果，尤其是苹果。
words.en: Used to single out a subject to which a statement is especially applicable.

words.ex: This tool is specially designed for children.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具是专门为儿童设计的。
words.en: In a special manner; particularly.

words.ex: The financial outlay is minimal for this project.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的财政支出是最小的。

words.tr: phrase. 少量的钱；一点点钱；为数不多的资金
words.ex: He has little money to buy food.
words.ex_cn: 他几乎没有钱买食物。
words.en: A small amount of money, often insufficient for major purchases.

words.ex: There is no charge for parking here.
words.ex_cn: 这里停车免费。
words.en: If there is no charge for something, it means that you do not have to pay for it.

words.tr: 短语动词. 花费一大笔钱；代价高昂
words.ex: The new car cost a fortune.
words.ex_cn: 这辆新车花了一大笔钱。
words.en: To cost a fortune means to be very expensive, requiring a large amount of money to purchase or maintain.

words.ex: The phone is expensive.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机很贵。
words.en: Costing a lot of money; having a high price.

words.tr: phrase. 支付一小笔行政费用
words.ex: You must pay for a small administrative fee to join the club.
words.ex_cn: 你要支付一笔小额管理费才能加入俱乐部。
words.en: For a small charge for administrative services.

words.tr: verb phrase付额外的费用【动词短语】
words.ex: He pays extra for faster delivery.
words.ex_cn: 他为更快的配送多付钱。
words.en: To pay an additional amount of money for something, often for a service or feature that is not included in the standard price.

words.tr: adj. 丰饶的；富有的；富裕的；
words.ex: The land is rich in minerals.
words.ex_cn: 这片土地矿物丰富。
words.en: Having a great deal of money or assets; wealthy.

words.ex: He built his wealth by starting a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他通过创办一家小企业积累了财富。
words.en: Wealth refers to an abundance of valuable possessions or money.

words.ex: The price of bread is too high.
words.ex_cn: 面包的价格太高了。
words.en: The amount of money expected, required, or given in payment for something.

words.tr: phrase. + adj. 完全免费的；彻底自由的
words.ex: The event was completely free, attracting a large crowd.
words.ex_cn: 这个活动完全免费，吸引了一大群人。
